translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Wach mokor nibiro timore ne jo-Moab

content.text: Ar manie Moab okethi,
omuke ei otieno achiel!
Kir manie Moab bende okethi,
omuke ei otieno achiel!
Jo-Dibon dhiyo e kargi mar lemo,
gidhiyo e hembko mag-gi mondo giywagi;
kendo jo-Moab goyo nduru nikech Nebo gi Medeba osekethi.
Ngʼato ka ngʼato oliel wiye kod tike.
E yore, girwako pien gugru;
to ewi udi kod laru maduongʼ,
giduto giywak ka gidengo kendo gingʼielore e lowo.
Jo-Heshbon kod jo-Eleale ywak,
kendo ywakgi winjore nyaka Jahaz.
Kuom mano jolweny mag jo-Moab ywak
kendo kihondko omakogi.
Chunya ywago jo-Moab;
nimar ogandane ringo kadhi pondo Zoar,
ma gichopo nyaka Eglath Shelishiya.
Gidhi ka giluwo yo mochomo Luhith ka giywak,
e yo madhi Horonaim giywak malit nikech kethruokgi.
Pige mag Nimrim oseduono,
kendo lum bende osener,
kendo oboke orumo,
maonge gimoro amora modongʼ ka ngʼich.
Omiyo mwandu mane giseloso
kendo kano negitingʼo magingʼadogo Holo ma Omburi otiye.
Ywakgi winjore nyaka e tongʼ Moab,
nduru margi chopo nyaka Eglaim,
kendo dengo margi landore nyaka Beer Elim.
Pige mag Dimon opongʼ gi remo,
to kata kamano named kelo masiche ne Dimon,
ne joge maringo koa Moab
mondo opondi kod jogo modongʼ e pinyno nomak gi sibuor.
